_about: Every word a player reads. Braces in a value are filled from what the core returns (a time, a name).
title: Surfs Up!
tagline: Saturday open gym. The mats are out, the foam pit is full, and surf_utopia is up.
join_hint: Type the room code your friend sees in their pause menu.
join_bad: That does not look like a room code.
name: Name
hud_start: Drop off the ledge to start the clock
banner_fell: Into the foam pit! Back to the start.
banner_early_exit: That was door {door}, an early way out. The clock only counts the doors at the very bottom.
banner_peer_run: {name} finished in {time}. Their ghost will surf with you.
banner_room_full: That room has eight surfers already.
online_no_bundle: the online code would not load
cubby_hint: Things to hold, earned on surf_utopia. Click one to hold it; Q swaps while surfing, and the mouse button squeezes.
need_best: Hold the best time in the gym.
live_hint: Off: the others only send their finished runs, and you race those as ghosts.
help_1: Ramps here are too steep to stand on, so you slide. Never hold W on a ramp: it takes you off the side.
help_2: Hold the strafe key toward the ramp's high side: A when the ramp rises to your left, D when it rises to your right. That keeps you on it.
help_3: Turn the mouse the same way as the key you hold. Turning into the strafe is what adds speed, in the air and along the ramp. Sync on the screen counts how often you match.
help_4: Look slightly down the ramp to go faster, up it to stay high. Falling is fine: the foam pit sends you back to the start.
help_keys: W A S D move · Space or scroll jump · Shift or C duck · R start over · mouse button squeeze · Q swap what you hold · Tab scoreboard · Esc pause
help_tip: Tip from the coach: rush B(leachers) after class, not during it.
no_webgl: This browser cannot draw 3D (WebGL 2), so Surfs Up! cannot run here.
invite_hint: No room code needed: send this invitation to one friend, paste their reply below, then make a new invitation for the next.
join_paste: Or join by a pasted invitation
join_paste_hint: Paste the invitation your friend sent, then send them back the reply.
code_bad: That code did not work. Ask for a fresh one.
